title: Version Badges
content: Create version and status badge displays. Version format: v1.2.3, v2.0.0-beta. Status badges: stable, beta, alpha, deprecated, latest. Colors: green for stable/latest, yellow for beta, orange for alpha, red for deprecated. Shield style: shields.io style badges. NPM/package style: name@version format. Comparison: current vs latest indicator. Changelog link: badge links to release notes. Update indicator: "New version available" notice. Auto-fetch: fetch latest version from npm/GitHub. Copy version: click to copy version string.

variants.simple: Display version numbers and status badges consistently.
variants.detailed: Create version and status badge displays. Version format: v1.2.3, v2.0.0-beta. Status badges: stable, beta, alpha, deprecated, latest. Colors: green for stable/latest, yellow for beta, orange for alpha, red for deprecated. Shield style: shields.io style badges. NPM/package style: name@version format. Comparison: current vs latest indicator. Changelog link: badge links to release notes. Update indicator: "New version available" notice. Auto-fetch: fetch latest version from npm/GitHub. Copy version: click to copy version string.
variants.advanced: Create version and status badge display system for packages and software. Version formats: semantic versioning (1.2.3), with prefix (v1.2.3), with tag (1.2.3-beta.1), full package (@scope/package@1.2.3). Status badges: stable (bg-green-100 text-green-800), beta (bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800), alpha (bg-orange-100 text-orange-800), deprecated (bg-red-100 text-red-800), latest (green outline), dev/nightly (gray). Shield.io style: two-part badge with label (gray) and value (colored), mimics shields.io design (rounded-l-full on left, rounded-r-full on right). Size variants: small (text-xs), default (text-sm), large (text-base). Comparison display: "1.2.0 to 1.3.0" showing upgrade path, current version vs latest indicator. Update available: banner or notice when new version exists, with changelog link. Interactive: click to copy version (navigator.clipboard), brief "Copied!" feedback. Link to changelog: badge links to GitHub release or changelog URL. Auto-fetch latest: optional API call to npm registry or GitHub releases to get latest version, cache result. Build status integration: can display alongside CI badge (passing/failing). Platform badges: OS compatibility (macOS, Windows, Linux), browser support. Release date: optional "Released Dec 15, 2024" below version. Pre-release indicator: "Pre-release" warning badge for alpha/beta. Documentation: link to version-specific docs.
